verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Auth0 supports one-time passwords (TOTP) and explicit 'Recovery codes' as backup codes alongside other MFA factors, and mention Adaptive/risk-based MFA and Strong Customer Authentication for sensitive-operation approval, which imply conditional/step-up-like enforcement. However, no citation explicitly documents a 'step-up authentication' policy/rule mechanism (e.g., per-app or per-action MFA enforcement) distinct from adaptive risk scoring. missing for 10: explicit step-up authentication policy documentation, hands-on/independent confirmation of TOTP+backup-code step-up flows in production.
